domain: finite-dimensional vector spaces over a finite field; indexed occurrences drawn from k geometric subspace classes U_1,...,U_k with multiplicities a_j >= 1
fixed_order_statement: For any occurrence order sigma and cut i, let A_i be classes having an occurrence at or left of i and B_i classes having an occurrence right of i. Then lambda_i = dim((sum_{j in A_i} U_j) intersect (sum_{j in B_i} U_j)). The complete cut-state sequence, up to duplicate consecutive states, is determined solely by the first and last occurrence of every class.
compression_statement: Deleting every occurrence that is neither the first nor the last occurrence of its geometric class preserves the set of cut support-state pairs (A_i,B_i), hence preserves every cut-width value set and the maximum layout width.
multiplicity_saturation_statement: For optimization over all layouts, replacing each multiplicity a_j by min(a_j,2) preserves path-width. Every layout compresses to a min(a_j,2)-layout with the same width; every compressed layout expands to arbitrary larger multiplicities by inserting middle copies between the first and last occurrence of that class without changing support states or width.
algorithmic_corollary: For fixed k, exact path-width of a repeated-class subspace arrangement can be computed by enumerating event orders of at most 2k retained occurrences (one event for singleton classes, ordered first/last events for repeated classes) and evaluating subset-sum intersections. Runtime is f(k) times polynomial linear-algebra work and is independent of multiplicities beyond reading the input.

k3_control_scope.multiplicity_signature: 1 or 2 for complete geometric controls; separate structural middle-copy controls up to multiplicity 4
k3_control_scope.purpose: falsification only; not the basis of the universal quantifier
